Alakazam nicknames

Origins and data

  • Ability: Synchronize or Inner Focus (Trace for Mega Alakazam)
  • Hidden Ability: Magic Guard
  • Height: 4’11” (1.5 m)
  • Weight: 105.8 lbs. (48.0 kg)

Alakazam was introduced in Generation 1 with a pure Psychic typing. Known as the Psi Pokémon, it’s a humanoid Pokémon with mustard yellow skin and a brown torso, cuffs, and knee pads. It has three fingers on each hand and three toes on each foot, a long moustache, and it holds two spoons

It also has a mega form, Mega Alakazam, introduced in Generation 6 which has a white moustache and beard, a red jewel on its forehead, and the brown parts are now longer and more purple. The two spoons are now five and levitate over its head.

Nicknames

My nicknaming methodology
  • I rank nicknames by lettered tiers: S, A, B, C, and D. S is the best and D is the worst.
  • I’ll usually list my inspiration for a nickname so you know where they came from.

S-Tier

  • The Magician - from tarot cards
  • Brainwasher - from Daft Punk
  • Giorgio/Moroder - the moustache
